name: Brian Worthington
office: Walnut Valley Water District, Member, Board of Directors, Division 2

items.text: Brian Worthington is the chair of the Diamond Bar Planning Commission and a commissioner on the PUSD Bond Oversight Committee, according to his campaign website. He previously served on the city's Parks & Recreation Commission. He was vice chair of the city's General Plan Advisory Committee.
